summary: Learn to prioritise NRW and energy improvements using utility metrics, investment scoring, and contract measures. Explore the course outline.
lede: Water utility NRW and energy-efficiency training helps operations, finance, and asset professionals quantify losses and energy use. Participants build an IWA water balance, compare energy-intensity indicators, diagnose pressure and pumping opportunities, and rank interventions against cost and service effects. They also draft performance measures for improvement contracts and create a monitoring plan with assigned data owners; ISO 50001 concepts are covered as practical guidance rather than full system implementation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for utility professionals who link network, pumping, treatment, and financial performance. It suits operational and finance roles that need a practical method for identifying, funding, and tracking NRW and energy improvements.
modules: IWA Water Balance and NRW Metrics
NRW and Energy KPI Monitoring Plan
prerequisites: Working familiarity with water or wastewater utility operations, finance, asset management, or engineering is recommended. No coding is required. Familiarity with basic spreadsheet calculations is useful.
